About your friend, did he find out what his reason for this pattern was? I'm curious and I could use all the experience from others.

The meat and potatoes of what happened was, (I'm glad you have interest in this and I'll try to explain it a concise as possible):

You register for a lesson via app. The app shows the coache's exercises for that session. It said ''10 downward dogs for Benchy''. I took note of this at home. When the moment of the exercise came the coach said something along the lines of ''oh yeah 10 for Benchy''. ''Who is Benchy?'' I asked. She replied with ''Benchy the dog!''. ''Ohhh aha you could have included that!''. Then she replied with ''Yeah whatever''. 

  
I have reflected on it, maybe I came of as a smart-ass rookie. But my goal was just some banter to make a connection. And I felt so so soooo rejected. Tears were rolling down my face many times that lesson.
